verification_report.summary: The full core proof is correct conditional on the stipulated torsion, missing-gradient, covariant-derivative, spectral-weight, coercivity and concavity inputs from stw_matrix_structure_01. The independent audit checks the Chern-parallel perturbation, eigenvalue bounds, twice-differentiated equation and torsion cancellations, explicit Hessian weight routing, derivative-cancellation lemma, numerical budgets, K-independent parameter choices, both eigenvalue cases and global propagation. The conjugated Gamma and mixed-Hessian bars agree with [STW Section 3](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1503.04491). In particular, 1/6-1/12-1/60=1/15 permits retaining 1/20 and obtaining 1/40. No uncontrolled pure-Hessian bound, prior second-order estimate or Gauduchon condition is used. The missing backslash in sum_kf_k is cosmetic. Detailed deductions and source comparisons are in [the full report](/Users/mingchen/Non-Kahler/research/rethlas/verification/results/stw_second_order_reconstruction_01/full_report.md) and the run's Rethlas records. This verdict does not independently certify the precursor. No book files were edited.
